tooling_defect.issue: The runner required exactly two graph/issued directions and four amount samples, rejecting a naturally admitted three-coin pool at inputs before executing any leg.
tooling_defect.fix: Require exact, nonempty, unique equality between every issued token direction and the Graph. Derive the unchanged positive/negative execution matrix size from all directions.
tooling_defect.regression: Seven entrypoint contracts passed, including two/three-coin coverage and missing, extra, duplicate, self and empty direction rejection; current production build passed.

evidence.result: Six directions, production reference and 10x, 24 positive executions with zero raw-unit input/output difference and 24 real no-current-input Reverts.
evidence.adjudication: Independent non-author reviewed the two-file change and original before/after response evidence; no blocking finding. Did not rerun EVM/build, inspect binary or verify original call-prestate.

limits: Tool fix and named same-N historical checks only. Not formal adapter_fixed, merge-ready, all-cohort success, original-TX output parity, full opportunity or performance acceptance. Separate pure-ERC20 uint adaptation gap remains open.
